name: agent-manager-harness-evidence-contract
description: Machine-checkable evidence requirements for Agent Manager Harness delivery.

deployEphemeral.pass: exitCode=0, rollout succeeds, and /api/health returns success from the isolated service

api.pass: exitCode=0, baseUrl is the isolated environment URL, and testsPassed=totalTests

e2e.pass: exitCode=0, baseUrl is the isolated environment URL, experienceUrl is usable, featureAssertions are present, screenshots/traces/log targets mention the requested feature or are explicitly marked featureSpecific=true, no console/network failures, desktop/mobile overflow <= 2

integrationLive.pass: exitCode=0 and live evidence is read back from the target system; if exitCode!=0 then classify failures before any downstream stage: external prerequisite patterns are identified before feature-token matching, related failures loop to develop, external-only failures may auto-continue only when relatedFailures=0 and unrelatedFailures=0, mixed unrelated failures await human

output.rule: Large payloads must be referenced as artifacts, not embedded in task output.
